note: A captures the NOTES equipment facts — 120/240 V sub-panel, 2.8 kW inverter with ground fault, 60 A DC NFDS, 200 A/2P NFDS, NEMA 3R junction box — which B omits entirely, while both parse the wiring schedule rows (20/31/32/33/34/50/150/151/10) correctly. B is padded with trivial per-row restatements (e.g. "conductor material CU") and mislabels the AL 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C. row as the "Main Service Panel connection," although the run to the main service panel is circuit 50 (CU 3#6, #8G., 1"C.). A makes that same misbinding in three vague "PV Equipment wiring … to main service panel" claims, plus assigns the ARMORED CABLE row to 150 (it is 151) and garbles 200A/2P as "200/2 A/P". On balance A's coverage of the important rated values outweighs its extra errors.
